### Cell-Cell Communication (Ligand-Receptor)
- **Cluster 0 → 12/18:** TNFSF12→CD163, C1QA→CD93 (immune regulation)
- **Cluster 12 → 18:** FN1/VCAN→CD44 (extracellular matrix-T cell crosstalk)
- **Cluster 18 → 0:** LTB→CD40, LTB→TNFRSF1A (T cell activation of microglia)
- **Cluster 3 → 18:** ICAM1→IL2RG, HLA-DRA→LAG3 (antigen presentation, immune checkpoint)

This reveals an active immune-tumor microenvironment with microglia/macrophage subsets interacting with T cells.
